product_one_liner.value: AmplifAI unifies contact-center data and uses AI to automate quality assurance, coaching, performance management and customer-experience insights for enterprises and BPOs.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the public site navigation/footer; the purchasing path is a demo request, and no public pricing page was found.

employee_band.notes: Normalized from a reported headcount of 168, rather than the broader 51–200 company-size range.

founded_year.notes: The company’s 2017 article explicitly says founded in 2014; its 2025 funding release instead says 2018. The discrepancy is not publicly explained; 2014 reflects the original business described contemporaneously.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is contact-center research, buyer guides, product news, coaching and CX marketing; no qualifying engineering-authored build-blog series was found.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation/help portal was found. The CX Learning Hub offers conceptual product education and case studies rather than a product help center or developer documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable careers board lists only Senior .Net Full Stack Developer - Plano, not a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: GPT-OSS 120b, self-hosted in private single-tenant Microsoft Azure environments or the customer’s environment.

compliance_certs.notes: Public vendor claims: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS are described as certifications; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance programs/claims, not standalone certifications.

last_funding.notes: The announced $33.7 million combines Series B funding and a credit facility; the equity-only amount is not disclosed in this announcement.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 23, 2025 announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The board’s sole listed opening is Senior .Net Full Stack Developer - Plano; no qualifying sales representative or account executive opening is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying launch was found for May 9–November 9, 2026. The latest identified product/platform announcement is the April 28, 2026 TTEC Perform collaboration, before the window; later awards and editorial content are not launches.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Luc Dallaire joined as SVP, Digital in July 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy explicitly names these tools for analytics, advertising and marketing data collection; this is internal website/marketing-stack evidence, not merely an integration listing.
